newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel steady even as crude rises.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel steady even as crude rises.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil prices were notionally little changed on Monday after a late surge in crude erased some of the weakness because of length in the market, traders said.
A number of cargoes were seen available in the prompt period, and buying interest was rather lacklustre.
High sulphur cargoes were thinly offered, and dealers said they thought premiums were little changed after an E-4 deal a couple of days ago at m/m/m +$5 or +$6.
